title: The past tense
summary: Say what you did and didn't do with the past in `-dY` (*geldim*, *gelmedim*, *Geldiňmi?*), tell its personal endings from the present's (*geldik*, *gelýäris*), and place things in time with *düýn*, *öňňin*, *geçen hepde*, *iki gün öň*, *eýýäm* and *entek*.
canDo: Say what you did yesterday, last week or a few days ago
Say what you didn't do, and ask others what they did
Tell the past and present endings apart
